private_lines.Prakash: You teach guitar to students at a small studio near your home in Mylapore, Chennai, and most of your days go to lessons, practice, and the odd rehearsal. You live with your parents, and your evenings are usually quiet after your last student.
private_lines.Meera: You work as a graphic designer from a home office in Adyar, Chennai, doing client projects on screen through the day. You share a flat with a flatmate, and your days are mostly work, a walk, and some time to yourself in the evening.
private_lines.Ganesh: You work as a civil engineer on construction sites around Chennai, leaving early in the morning and getting back by evening. You live alone in a flat in Velachery, and your days are mostly site visits, paperwork, and a quiet dinner.
